recent.text: The good news is that Zuccarello said he feels "100 percent" and sitting out a bit longer this time got him there. "I felt normal for the first time in a while, that I could actually skate the way I wanted. It was a really good step, personally."
recent.author: Zach Dooley
recent.quoted_text: Mats Zuccarello said his "body wasn't playing on the same team" as him to start the year. "You have standards for yourself & it's really frustrating to feel like you aren't contributing to the team. It's tough, especially when you're new & want to make a good impression & help."
